result.brief: 提出 dNaViT 离散视觉 tokenizer：在冻结编码器上以残差调制与双分支目标注入重建线索，并用分组乘积量化扩展离散容量，统一支撑理解与生成任务。
result.reason: Discrete visual tokenizer built on frozen encoder with residual modulation and product quantization, serving both understanding and generation—directly a visual representation/tokenizer contribution for unified models.
